reproducible_candidate_check.command:
PYTHONPATH=tools:tools/api_inventory python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip, json
from api_crosswalk import header_owners, cpp_indexes, rust_crates, match_api_row
headers=json.load(open('porting/api-header-manifest.json'))
with gzip.open('porting/api-inventory/occt-declarations.jsonl.gz','rt') as f:
    cpp=[json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]
by_name,_,_=cpp_indexes(cpp,header_owners(headers))
rust=rust_crates(json.load(gzip.open('porting/api-inventory/rust-api.json.gz','rt')))
known={row['path'] for row in headers['headers'] if isinstance(row.get('path'),str)}
rows=[]
for row in json.load(open('porting/parity.json'))['api']:
    name=row.get('upstream_id','')
    if name.startswith('NCollection_DefaultHasher') or name in {f'NCollection_BaseMap::{m}() const' for m in ('NbBuckets','Extent','Length','Size','IsEmpty','Allocator')}:
        rows.append(match_api_row(row,by_name,rust,known))
assert len(rows)==40 and all(row['cpp_status']=='unique' and row['rust_status']=='unique' for row in rows)
print('40 selectors resolve uniquely on both sides')
PY
